properties.site-address: Land south of Graylingwell Drive, Chichester, West Sussex
properties.notes: Demolition of existing hospital buildings and development of up to 160 new homes including retention and improvement of sports pitch/open space, new pavilion and children's play area; restoration of Martin's Farm house for residential use (included in 160 unit total); access arrangements and ancillary works and demolition of pavilion.
